hits.title: Backuply - Store Backup & Restore
hits.summary: Your store's undo button. Continuous backup with version history—restore products, pages & more from the Vault, not a zip file.
hits.description: Backuply – Automatic Backup & Restore for BigCommerce Protect your BigCommerce store from accidental deletions, unwanted changes, app errors, failed imports, and automation mistakes with Backuply. Automatic Store Backups Backuply automatically backs up your critical store data, so you always have a recovery point when something goes wrong. Set it up once and let Backuply protect your store in the background. Restore When Things Go Wrong Deleted a product? Made an incorrect bulk update? An app changed something unexpectedly? Quickly restore individual items or recover larger sets of data from an earlier backup without manually rebuilding your store. What Backuply Protects Backuply is designed to protect important BigCommerce data, including: Products and product images Categories and brands Customers and orders Inventory Pages and content Redirects Other supported store data Backup History Access previous backups and recover the version you need. Backup history provides an additional safety net against human error, integrations, bulk updates, and AI-powered automations. Secure Cloud Backups Your backups are securely stored separately from your live store, helping ensure your data remains available when you need to recover it. Simple Setup. Automatic Protection. Install Backuply, configure your backup preferences, and let it take care of the rest. Backuply – Automatic backups. Fast recovery. Peace of mind.

hits.title: Amplience eComm Toolkit
hits.summary: Maps core commerce information from BigCommerce into Amplience's CMS, Dynamic Content, automatically​
featuresList: Increased efficiency for merchants and marketers
hits.description: The Amplience eComm Toolkit removes the "swivel chair" approach between BigCommerce and Amplience Dynamic Content (CMS), creating a single place for business teams to build fast, relevant and personalized commerce experiences for their customers. The easy-to-implement extension automatically maps three core commerce functions into Amplience; removing the reliance on manual processes, speeding up content production time and removing the potential for human error, creating a much better experience for business users. The eComm Toolkit maps the following commerce functions: Category Mapping: Maps commerce categories from BigCommerce into Amplience, automating the population of category IDs and category display names. This makes it easy for business users to edit navigation components or hierarchies, without referencing the commerce platform. Product Mapping: Enables users to search and select products from BigCommerce to populate a content item in Amplience. This makes it easy to build features such as product carousels, or to populate a curated product listing page, without flipping back to BigCommerce to reference. The search is populated based on product IDs, keyword or categorization. Content Personalization Mapping: Maps user groups/segments from BigCommerce into Amplience. This makes it easy for business users to create content experiences tailored to their unique audiences by pulling in targeted user segments, without having to flip back and reference BigCommerce. Note: Requires self-hosting.

summary.value: Maps core commerce information from BigCommerce into Amplience's CMS, Dynamic Content, automatically​

consentPreferenceCenter.title: Privacy Preference Center
consentPreferenceCenter.description: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

strictlyNecessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
strictlyNecessary.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

targeting.title: Targeting Cookies
targeting.description: These cookies may be set through our site by us and/or our third-party service providers. They may be used by us and/or our third-party service providers to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites and/or devices. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
